balls.text: good ball to end, in the blockhole, Albie manages to smash it towards long-on, Dhoni is extremely quick between the wickets and he's easily back for the second before Dwayne Smith's throw comes in
another reverse-sweep from Dhoni, not very well-timed though, only a single to short third man
RP tries the bouncer, it was on legstump, Dhoni tries to pull it again, flies off his glove to the fine leg boundary
Dhoni reaches his half-century with another savage pull, the placement was fanatastic, there wan't too muich of a gap between midwicket and deep square leg
down the legside and he'll have re-bowl that one
outside off, length ball, Albie tries to swipe it, gets a bottom edge towards midwicket, more importantly Dhoni's on strike
back of a length ball, follows Albie, who tries to chip it over slips but misses the ball
whoah, where did that come from, reverse-sweep to a fast bowler, Dhoni doesn't get the placement right, finding short third man, but Shoaib Maqsusi misfeilds to give away three extra runs
low full toss on legstump, whacked down the ground, Albie pushes for the second, the throw is some six feet wide of the stumps, so the batsmen are safe
he backs away and mows it over midwicket for a boundary, just gets his front foot out of the way and clobbers it
yorker just outside off, Albie digs it out towards point for a single
great ball to start, very full outside off, Albie swings and misses, ball sneaks under his bat
Dhoni slaps it to long-on who rushes in to keep the batsmen down to one
RP gets rid of Raina to end an excellent over, it was overpitched on middle and leg, Raina was looking to clear long-on but only managed to provide a low catch to Dwayne Smith on the boundary
full, on middle and leg, Dhoni goes on his knee, and sweeps towards backward square leg
bouncer this time, takes Raina by surprise, he pulls it awkwardly towards square leg
low full toss on offstump, clobbered towards long-on, placement isn't terrific though, so only a single
great yorker, Raina was backing away, RP following him with one in the blockhole, Raina manages to dig it out towards square leg, he looked pretty ungainly there
shortish ball, on middle and off, Dhoni clubs it off the backfoot towards long-on, one bounce before reaching the fielder
a lot fuller on off, squeezed out towards cover for a single to end the over
streaky, but Chennai will take it, it was a back of a length on middle and off, Dhoni backed away and looked to cut, a thick edge takes it racing past short third man for four
a touch fuller, Raina swings it to long-on off the backfoot, a couple of bounces before it reaches Gibbs at the boundary
short and a touch wide outside off, Raina wanted to play a cute dab just wode of the keeper, but he fails to connect with the ball
back of a length on offstump, Dhoni stays on the backfoot and twirls it towards third man
fullish ball on offstump, Dhoni absolutely butchers it down the ground for a boundary, not elegant but pretty effective
swept towards deep backward square leg, Rain called for two immediately and they get it comfortably
on the pads, again square leg has work to do after Dhoni nudges it in that region
low full toss on the pads, 90kmh, Raina swings it towards square leg for a single
cut towards point this time, that was pretty slow from Ojha, 78kmh
Raina backs away to the legside to make room, and drives that full ball towards extra cover
Dhoni comes down the track to convert Ojha's first ball into a low full toss, he pummels it towards long-off for a single
Dhoni rounds over a good over for Chennai with a single towards deep extra cover
attempts the shot again, but gets a bottomg edge towards third man
Raina on the rampage, this ball was a bit shorter, but it goes in the same direction, even bigger than the previous one, this is just what Chennai need
a repeat and this time it goes a long way, the only one with a chance of catching it was a man in the crowd, who does, and jumps about for joy
Raina gets down on one knee and bisects the gap between long-on and midwicket, there wasn't enough on it to go all the way, bounce in safe territory though
fullish outside off, scythed towards the sweeper on the offside boundary
slower full toss on offstump, 107 kmh, Dhoni thumps it down the ground towards long-on
Raina moves to the leg side and drives it inside out towards extra cover for a single
Dhoni tries to launch that 118kmh ball over long-off, doesn't quite get hold of it, lands just short of Dwayne Smith at long-off, who does very well to stop it from getting to the boundary
shorter from Shoaib, Raina mistimes it towards cover for a single
Dhoni also turns it towards square leg, an inside-edge onto his pads and it rolls away square
just outside off, Raina stays on the backfoot and dabs it towards backward point
length ball from Suman, "Catch" cries Gilchrist as Raina pops it back to the right of the bowler, who dives but can't hold on to it, very difficult chance that
nice foot work from Dhoni again, takes a couple of paces down the track to get to the pitch and punches it to long-on
Raina leans forward and drives to long-off for a single
tossed up, full and outside off, Raina slaps it towards midwicket, good running gets them two
full and outside off, Dhoni works it towards covers for a single

T Suman strikes, Vijay seemed to have got a lot of bat on that, it was in the slot and he looked to slam it over long-off after shimmying down the pitch, just doesn't get enough on it, Gibbs takes the catch a few yards in from the boundary
dances down the track and smashes it down the ground, but placement is poor, one bounce to long-off
Dhoni was coming down the track, Ojha saw him and pushed it wide outside off, too wide ofr the umpire's liking
just outside off, Vijay roacks onto his backfoot and dabs it towards backward point
defended towards cover off the front foot
this time he taps it towadrs covers for a single
Dhoni's shows us he hasn't lost any of his power-hitting skills,  he comes down the ground and absolutely hammers it over the bowler's head for a massive six
fullish, Dhoni tries to muscle it down the ground off the backfoot, timing wasn't too good so long-off can get around to stop it
on middle and leg, turned towards wide mid-on by Vijay
similar delivery, this time Vijay punches it towards extra cover, another dot ball
length ball outside off, Vijay lunges at it and gets an edge towards backward point
shorter and outside off, Dhoni plays it towards point off the backfoot
full on the pads, pushed towards midwicket
on middle and leg, Vijay gets down on his knee and sweeps it behind square for a single, and that'll be the strategic time-out
again he advacnes down the track, this time he pushes it towards cover to get a single
down the pitch again, slams it down the ground, straight at the bowler who manages to stop it
ooh, catch was the call after Dhoni tried to chip it over the bowler's head after charging down the track
full, flighted and on legstump, Vijay waits for it and turns it behind square for a single
offstump ball, Dhoni shuffles down the track and punches it to mid-on for a single
overpitched and wide, Dhoni reachs out and cracks that through the covers, but there's a sweeper in the deep, so that'll only be a single
much fuller this time, pushed towards mid-on for a single
Smith shortens his length a touch, on offstump, Vijay pokes it towards point
lovely shot from Vijay, whacked over midwicket for a six off the  front foot
shortish on middle stump, turned towards midwicket, no run
another good looking shot from Vijay, a front-foot on-drive, Ryan Harris raced to it from long-on but misfields allowing the batsmen to come back for two
similar delivery, Dhoni taps it towards mid-off but there's not enough time to take a single
on middle and leg, Dhoni plays it back to the bowler
stick to that leg-stump line, worked to square leg for a single
outside legstump this time from Ojha, Vijay gets down on his knee and tries to paddle-sweep it, hits his pads and runs away very fine for a boundary
on the pads again, Dhoni gets off the mark with a nudge towards square leg
starts with a middle stump ball, Vijay turns it away to square leg for a single
good ball from Shoaib to start, just back of a length, in the channel outside off, Dhoni is beaten as he tries an off drive
Shoaib has the last laugh, Hayden's gone, that ball was very close to offstump, Hayden goes for the cut anyway, a top edge ends up in a low catch for RP Singh at short third man

a Hadyen special, he decides if Shoaib is going to bowl so slow he walk down the pitch to meet it, he was at least three paces down before he smoked that over the bowler's head, total disrespect for the bowler
Shoaib keeps it short, Hayden stays on the backfoot and slams it towards cover, straight to the fielder
114kmh this time, Hayden was looking to shovel that shortish ball over midwicket, but he was through the shot before the ball came on
starts with a short and wide ball, 110 kmh, Hayden waits for it and hammers it through the covers for four
keep the strike with a single towards midwicket, he's moved on to 35 already
on the pads, Hayden shuffles actross and dabs it towards midwicket
oh he gets hold of that one, down the track and smashed over wide long-off for a huge six
played off the backfoot to the covers
he's not going to hang around, waltzes down the track and tries to power it down the ground, mishit back to the bowler
fullish on the pads, whipped away to square leg for a single
on the stumps this time, Vijay tries a repeat of his wristy drive to mid-on, mistimes it and the ball flies in the air before landing safely short of mid-on
outside off stump, Vijay goes for the cut but is beaten
a bottom edge towards midwicket, batsmen hare through for a single, Vijay just about made it to the crease
another six off a mishit, Hayden again bent his knee to get under and hammer it over cover, mishit over long-on sails over the ropes
shorter and wider from Smith, not much elegance from Hayden here, he crashes it towards extra cover but straight ot the fielder
better from Smith, just outside off, Vijay goes on the backfoot and elegantly works the ball to mid-on for a quick single
starts off with a terrible delivery, way down the leg side, Gilchrist does well to get a glove on it when standing up to the stumps
on the pads this time, Vijay says thank you and clips it towards backward square leg, it looks headed for a boundary until Ryan Harris puts in a full-length dive near the rope
beauty from RP, again going across Vijay, who was trying to drive it towards extra cover, he's beaten
shortish ball, angling across Vijay, who plays with soft hands towards cover, a loud shout of 'No' ensures neither batsmen set off for a single
a lot fuller from RP, turned away to deep square leg by Hayden for a single
Hayden's stepping on it here, a bit of width from RP, Hayden bends his knees to get under the ball, a thick top edge as he throws the bat at it, enough to carry the ball over the third man boundary
just a touch short from RP, that's all Hayden needs, he carves powerfully over cover for a boundary
slower ball to finish the over, on a length, tight line, Vijay taps it towards extra cover
fullish from Harris, just outside off, Hayden bends and guides the ball towards third man for another single
this time he gets a single, opening the face and running it to third man
just back of a length, on middle and off, Vijay jumps onto his backfoot and defends towards the bowler
in the channel outside off, Vijay defends watchfully off the backfoot
another four, Murali is all finesse compared to Hayden's brute strength so far, lovely square drive races away on the quick outfield
another swing from Hayden to a ball outside off, again he is beaten
overpitched from RP, Hayden shuffles across and tries to slap it to midwicket, gets an edge which takes the ball towards sqaure leg, he wouldn't mind as it fetches him four runs
length ball, around the offstump, Hayden was down the track to loft over the bowler's head, mistimes it to the keeper
much better from RP, spearing towards middle and leg, pegs Hayden to the backfoot, he defends it back down the pitch
outswing for RP but that started from too wide outside the offstump
back of a length, and a bit wider this time, Hayden advances down the track as he regularly does and tries to swipe it to midwicket, misses the ball
RP Singh starts off with a corker, fractionally outside the offstump, Hayden was looking to drive that past mid-off, he's beaten
wonderful shot from Vijay to finish the over, just leans into a classical offdrive, placement and timing is perfect, no chance for any of the fielders, great start for Chennai
width for Hayden this time, he tries to carve it past point, edges it through to third man
Hayden doesn't take much time to get going, that was on legstump, around waist high, easy pickings for Hayden, swings it down to fine leg for four
a touch short, bit of room for Hadyen, who swings at it but misses
again it jags away a touch, Vijay was looking to tuck it to square leg, gets an outside edge towards point
he's on target right away, just back of a length outside off and a hint of movement away, Vijay lets that one go
and it's all over, an absolutely action-paced innings comes to an end, Ojha swipes it straight to man-of-the-moment Jakati at midwicket to bring the curtain down
on the legstump, turned in sharprly, defended off the backfoot
tries to slam it down the ground, deflected by Raina towards long-off, Deccan's hundred comes up
tossed up by Raina, defended towards extra cover by Shoaib

Deccan are doing a house-of-cards impersonation here, another wicket gone, virtually an action replay of the previous ball, Suman gets a bit of an edge though and it sails high before Vijay takes another catch
Deccan are falling apart here, simple wicket for Murali, overpitched on middle and leg, RP swipes it straight down the throat of M Vijay at midwicket
sharp turn, pitches on middle and jags back towards RP, who is cut in half by it
again on legstump, RP can't get it away
Sumna gets a big stride in as he defends, edged onto his pads and it ballons towards the offside, lands safely though
Murali targets the leg stump, nudged towards short fine leg
down the track and slogged to long-on for a single
arm ball again, gets an inside-edge onto his pads
arm ball does the trick for Jakati, Harris goes for a wild heave, he missed and offstump is rocked back, another four wicket haul for Jakati, what is it with the IPL and little-known Goa players?
short ball, Harris goes for the cut, gets a thick bottom edge which bounces through to the keeper
played watchfully off the backfoot towards point
pulled towards deep midwicket for a single
pushed to covers for a single
Suman follows the Smith method of giving it everything, cracks it over the bowler's head for a boundary
another drop, is there another twist in this match, a mishit from Suman flies towards Badrinath at mid-off, who positions himself nicely under the ball before making a meal of the catch
dropped by Raina, a full-blooded drive from Suman goes only as far as the bowler who can't latch on to it
super shot from Suman, a touch short outside off, Suman gives himself room and cracks it past cover for a boundary
Suman charges down the track and slams it down to long-off, couple of bounces before it reaches the fielder
fired in on offstump, squirted away to fine leg by Harris

Jakati gets one more, and this match should be in the bag for Chennai, Venugopal dances down the track to get to the pitch of a legstump ball, he smacks it over to long-on only to find Murali waiting to take the catch
Suman backs away and cuts a shortish ball towards point
full on middle and leg, swept along the ground to deep fine leg
angling in towards legstump, Suman comes down the track to work it to leg, hits his pads and trickles to the offside
sharp turn after pitching on a good length, Venugopal adjusts at the last moment to play it down the track
this was on the pads, flicked in the air towards deep midwicket
this time Venugopal pushes it towards point for a single
a wide down the leg side
huge appeal for lbw, hit in front of middle but the height may have saved the batsmen
played tosquare leg for a single
doosra, and Suman is beaten as he tries to work it to the leg side
Smith is gone lbw, hit in front of middle as he tries to sweep, Jakati has taken two big wickets here, that ends an absolute gem from Smith
takes a couple of steps down the track and punches to long-on for a single
comes forward and pushes it to cover

a mental match becomes crazier still, there were at least four chances to run out Smith there, Smith hit it to deep point, the bowler doesn't collect the return, Badrinath backing up, throws it back to the bowler who doesn't collect the throw again but breaks the stumps, Smith and Suman were almost at the same end at this time, Jakati picks the ball and tries to hand it to Badrinath who is at the stumps now but flicks it wide of him, before Smith finally gets home
Jakati breaks the partnership, Rohit holes out to midwicket, the batsman was trying to repeat the previous stroke but got it too square
classy shot from Rohit, the runs continue to come in a torrent, Rohit comes down the track and lofts it over mid-on for a boundary
faster ball, 88kmh from Murali, that was a doosra as well, very wide outside off and lucky to not be called a wide
supreme timing from Smith, he shows us he's not all about power by paddle sweeping a full delivery for fouor
sticks to the legstump line, Rohit remains on the backfoot and turns it behind square for a single
comes down the track and looks to sweep, but fails to connect with the ball, and is hit on the pads
another full ball, just outside leg, hits Smith's pads and trickles away behind square leg
overpitched ball, Rohit's down the ground to punch it to long-on
Smith was eyeing the crowd behind midwicket again, an almighty mow doesn't connect with the ball though
that ball came in with the drift, squeezed to square leg for a single
turn for Jakati, Smith pokes it towards point
Smith keeps smashing away, yet another six, that was a touch short, Smith gets on the back foot, gets his front foot out of the way and clobbers it over midwicket
fired into towards legstump, Rohit whips it to midwicket for a single
arm ball first up, flicked to square leg for a single
back of a length, Rohit stays on the backfoot, and turns it to mid-on, Smith wanted the single but is sensibly sent back by Rohit
full ball outside off, pushed to mid-on for a single
Smash! Smith continues his swing-at-everything policy, and it's coming off, this time it's over cow corner for another six
allows the ball to come ontop him, closes the face of the bat to direct it to midwicket and takes a single
Balaji responds with bouncer, Rihit swivels and pulls it past deep backward square leg for another boundary
Balaji is welcomed with a hoick over mid-on for six, Rohit joins in the fun, that was an elegant shot
short of a length on middle, Rohit tries to work it to midwicket, strikes his pad and rolls towards point, another leg bye
a yorker on legstump, good response from Albie, Smith scrambles a leg-bye off it
goes for it again, but it is mishit,  it still rockets over the bowler's head for  a boundary
whoah, even better, what a stroke from Smith, sensational timing as he flicks Morkel way over the midwicket boundary, hardly any power but that ball travelled
sweet hit from Smith, another full toss, lower than the first one, Smith just flicks it nonchalantly over midwicket for a flat six
big shout for lbw from Morkel, after Smith is rapped on the pads on legstump, but that was sliding down leg
wild delivery from Morkel, a waist-high full toss on leg stumo after the attempted yorker goes wrong, Smith barely gets out of the way
goes for the pull, bottom-edges the ball and it trickles towards deep square leg for single
this time it's a clean hit from Smith, overpitched on offstump, Smith takes a big stride forward and carves it over mid-off for a six
on middle and leg, rohit tucks it towards mid-on and gets a single to get off the mark
Rohit's beaten outside offstump, as he fishes for one outside offstump
similar ball, Rohit slaps it towards point but doesn't beat the fielder
Tyagi is much better with the ball, back of a length on off, defended by Rohit
Smith is leading a charmed life here, he tries to clip the ball to midwicket, gets a top edge which swirls towards third man, where a howler Sudeep Tyagi keeps Smith at the crease, that was a dolly
oh my god, Dwayne Smith should have been gone, three fielders gathered around that mishit from Smith, extra cover, cover and deep point converge but no one goes for it
tight line around offstump, Smith pokes it towards point
Dwayne Smith gets the first runs off the bat by dabbing the ball towards third man
and another wicket gone, Deccan in disarray, Laxman adds to ducks on the scorecard by chipping a legstump delivery to midwicket, elegant shot but played in the air and straight to the fielder
very full and outside off, seemed that Laxman didn't pick it reacted late with a swish that didn't connect
that jagged away after pitching just outside off and had Rohit chasing after it, beauty of a delivery to end the over
in the blockhole, Rohit jams it towards mid-on, no run again, Deccan are yet to make a run with the bat
good ball again, back of a length on middle and leg, worked towards midwicket, straight to the fielder
length ball on offstump, Rohit defends it watchfully towards the leg side
Timber! Taygi bowls Gibbs, full ball on middle and legs, Gibbs tries to whip it away to midwicket, misses, and the ball hits his pada and ricochets onto the stumps, Deccan in big trouble here
that was a poor ball, though, way down the legside, and Deccan are finally off the mark
on target straightaway, back of a length on offstump, pushed towards point by Gibbs
in the channel again, pitched up, Laxman punches it towards extra cover, no run again, and that's a maiden, great start from Albie
same line, just outside off, but much shorter, Laxman defends it back down the pitch off the backfoot
superb delivery, some late movement for Albie, Laxman was feeling for it outside off and is beaten
Albie is getting a bit of outswing going here, Laxman drives again, uppishly but it lands before reaching extra cover
short of a length outside off, Laxman leans into the drive and caresses it towards cover, doesn't beat the fielder
what a start! Albie strikes, full ball, Gilchrist looks to whack it towards midwicket, misses the ball and is struck low on his back leg, the umpire didn't have to think too hard about that one
